scope: Separately stored audit checkpoint verification with explicit trust policy and unavailable status; hash chain alone not immutable (C25 / F19)

results.C25: Separately stored audit checkpoints verified with explicit TrustPolicy, Ed25519 cryptographic signatures, and explicit VerificationStatus codes (including UNAVAILABLE). Proved that local hash chain alone is not immutable (UNANCHORED_CHAIN). Tested and verified all 10 negative failure cases: single-byte mutations in events, log root, and signature; sink unavailability; untrusted signer; stale/forked revision replays; timestamp expiration; and zero plaintext canary leakage.
